name: What's the difference between cabinet painting and cabinet refacing?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between cabinet painting and cabinet refacing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet painting involves applying a new finish to your existing cabinet doors, drawer fronts, and frames, refreshing their appearance. Cabinet refacing, on the other hand, involves replacing the doors and drawer fronts entirely with new ones, and applying a new veneer to the existing cabinet boxes. Painting is generally more affordable and quicker, while refacing offers a more significant change in style. We can discuss both options for your Berkeley home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting updates existing cabinet finishes; refacing replaces doors/drawer fronts and veneers cabinet boxes for a bigger change.
